classes.definition: Schafer/Truax: keynote (the floor) · signal (the event) · rhythm (periodic keynote) · soundmark (identity; ↺ = album hook)
classes.note: soundmark = voice: all 439 VOX chops + 14 READINGs + the 37 pack segments whose speech flag is true. song rows (34 SONG + 744 SEG) carry cent=0/flat=0/key='' — unmeasured, not silent. Embedding towers: FORM = DINOv2 on 256px log-spectrograms · MEANING = CLAP (laion/clap-htsat-unfused) · phrases matched from the 847 operative ekphrases

atlas: 'loops that prove their seam, beds that hold still, hits that rise from silence, textures, risers'. BED/TEXTURE/RISER are fixed-length windows (7.99/4.99/3.99 s); bpm is 0 for every non-LOOP; 8 'loud' values (6 LOOP, 2 RISER) are unnormalised (millions), so use medians — a data bug.
genreGroup is 'WORLD' for all 916; tempo is -1 for every non-LOOP row; keySignature present on 210 of 916 (the pack only).
223 bar-cut VOLHOLLA song elements (pack/songloops, 33 songs, all with key+tempo) + the 439 voice chops. This is the 'orchestra' pool.

classes.definition: ts/te = valley+zero-snapped tight cut; tl = with trailing air; gi/go = cut-point energy vs word peak (dB); grade A clean / B safe / C fused

elements.name: reading

elements.name: line sample
elements.what: one read line cut from the reading

properties.earSketch: instrument VOCALS, genre ATLANTIS, tempo -1, no key

elements.name: word cut
elements.what: a single word recut to energy valleys + zero crossings
elements.mix_use: reconstitute assembles new sentences word by word (grade A=4, B=2, C=0 score; f0 continuity; ideal 0.45 s length)

elements.name: chop / VOX power phrase
elements.what: 1–3-word power phrase cut from the 32-bit masters, 12 ms edge fades
elements.mix_use: CLAP-sketch/ES+ seal sample material; pacing-desk whisper pool (40); sonic-field soundmarks

elements.name: voice take / dressing
elements.what: a re-dressed copy of a spoken take (vintage/delay/room versions in DOG/LIZARD/ANT folders)
elements.mix_use: censused, never played; genome proposes erosion by SWAPPING dressings

elements.name: line variant (other recording of a line)

elements.mix_use: listed under each poem world; never mixed

elements.name: codex sung line (mouth)
elements.what: one poem line sung by another mouth, cut from a carrier song and twin-timed to her reading

elements.name: carrier song (full-poem song)

elements.name: isolated song vocal (demucs VOCALS)

elements.name: loop

elements.name: bed

elements.name: hit

elements.name: texture

elements.name: riser
elements.what: 4-second rising-energy segment

elements.name: VOLHOLLA song

elements.name: bar-quantized song element

elements.name: orchestra stem (songloop chair)

elements.name: demucs stem bass+drums

elements.name: demucs OTHER stem

elements.name: ghost

elements.name: foley / hit-on-cue

elements.name: whisper (poet phrase in film silence)

elements.name: tape loop (disintegrating)

elements.mix_use: beneath the untouched voice; DECAY AS FORM gene (Basinski)

elements.name: drifted word (two octaves down)

elements.name: key-bed

elements.mix_use: always some sound

elements.name: synth voice (ES+ seal fallback)
elements.what: code-synthesised kick/hat/bass/lead when no sample resolves
elements.mix_use: workshop only

elements.name: silence / breath gap

elements.name: MANTA variant mixes

mix_rules.numbers: speaking = rms > 0.012 (fftSize 1024); floor = 1 - 0.9*amt; duckGain setTargetAtTime tc 0.03 (bow) / 0.16 (rise)
peaking 1400 Hz, Q 0.7, gain -7*amt dB while speaking (tc 0.03 / release 0.2)
voxBus gain 0.12 while speaking, 1 otherwise (tc 0.03 / 0.25); layers with 'vox|voice|word' labels, soundmarks, VOCALS chairs route here
highshelf 2800 Hz +2.5 dB on the voice
DynamicsCompressor threshold -18, knee 12, ratio 3, attack 0.01, release 0.25
two feedback delays [0.29 s fb 0.42],[0.47 s fb 0.36], lowpass 2200 Hz; echoIn 0.9, echoWet 0.8; echo also ducks

level voice 100, keynote 22, rhythm 30, else 28; depth keynote 70, signal 40, song 65, else 55; orchestra depth BASS 22 DRUMS 35 PIANO 45 STRINGS 55 SYNTH 62 VOCALS 72 SFX 55; DRUMS level 18, other chairs 24; pan ±(0.3+0.18*(i%3)); referred sounds pan ±0.35
drone gain 0.22 fadeIn 1.5 fadeOut 2; reading gain 1 at poem_enters; sounds gain 0.26 every 3.5 s from 2 s
a sound enters a world only if CLAP-matched via the poem's own shots with >=2/3 vote (5 of 58 entries are strict:false)

voice-band SNR >= 13 dB during every measured word; zero collisions in the silences; outro >= 6 dB below body; CLAP juror margin > 0.02 toward 'a cinematic score with clear spoken word' vs 'a muddy mix'

accompaniment mid band 200–4500 Hz bows under every measured word, 30 ms attack, 300 ms rise; bass keeps 88%; air stays open; voice dead centre, orchestra spread; everything lands only in the poet's silences
44 passes over 14 stations; actions: deepen the bow x24, deepen the bow+resolve x5, deepen resolve x1, accepted x14 — every revision is attenuation (genome)
render transcribed by whisper; >= 85% of the poem's words must survive; all 14 passed first pass (0.925–0.99); 119 words lost total
kept_of_possible = mix recovery / clean-master ceiling; range 0.943–1.0; 1.0 = 'the real 100%'
content-token Jaccard >= 0.42, in order
poet < 3.0 poet_dist threshold set by eye; codex singers 6.8–17.7 vs readings at 1

choir mouth may begin only if springDone && springQuiet > 2.0 s; quiet = rms < 0.015; speaking = rms > 0.02; after a mouth ends wait 7 s, mouthWait = T+10 at start; mouths = fit!==false, top 6 by jaccard
yield to 0 with tc 0.045 overrides wear/dropouts; choir release tail when < 0.55 s left
key-bed target 0.045 speaking / 0.09 breath / 0.13 after; ground (drone) 0.05 / 0.09 / 0.14; waves 0.03 / 0.12 / 0.26; bases: ground 0.24, bed 0.10, sfx 0.16, choir 0.85
signals only, dur <= 5 s, max 8; one at a time only when rms < 0.02; next after 9 + hash%7 s; release when < 0.7 s left
lowpass = 8000*exp(-w/900)+300 Hz; dropout probability min(0.35, w/700)*dt; dropout 0.09–0.26 s then 0.4 s guard; wear persisted in localStorage
power on: master tc 0.4 to 0.95; off: tc 0.25 then pause after 900 ms; retune dip 0.05 then 0.95
root = foldRoot(score.root || drone.base || 41.2) into [32,64) Hz; pick PIANO/STRINGS/SYNTH songloop whose tonic == NOTE(root) else NOTE(root*1.5) else any chair

speaking = any word with ct in [s-0.04, e+0.08]; flood target 0.10 speaking / 0.85 tide|ebb / 1.0 otherwise; tc 0.05 bow / 0.55 bloom; tide 6 s before her; 1.6 s before mouths, 1.2–1.4 s gap between mouths, 14 s ebb; top 5 mouths by jaccard
crest > 0.55 darkens (construction), > 0.8 shimmer; amp = (0.25+0.75*flood)*(1-0.8*decay); ground = E.ground*(0.4+0.6*flood); attack = E.attack + 0.5*flood
56 bands x 64 cols; gate one-pole 30 ms; skip a < 0.004; g = a^atk * 1.15; accent adds x1.4983 partial *6; out tanh*0.9; phase never reset

hit candidates at kind-change cuts + scene starts; min 7 s apart; land if inside a silence [t0+0.2, t0+dur-0.8], else next silence within 3.0 s with dur >= 1.0 at t0+0.12; hit gain 0.42, pan ±0.4, max 2.2 s
silence >= 3.5 s, >= 18 s since last; whisper must fit dur-0.8; gain 0.5; ducks film to 0.42 of its volume
one bed per scene gain 0.13, 1.5 s fade-in, 1.2 s crossfade

voice line chosen by token overlap >= 2 (tokens > 3 letters), dur <= sec-0.6, starts at t0+clamp((sec-dur)*0.12,0.2,0.8); a cue under her words snaps to line end +0.15 s (skipped if > sec-0.5); hits = signals <= 3.5 s gain (cue.gain||0.4)*0.95 pan ±0.35; ghost at voice end +0.6 s if >= 4 s room, gain 0.3, pan ±0.4, <= 6 s; beds rotate non-DRUMS chairs gain 0.12, fade 1.4 s; event ramps 0.05 in / 0.25 out; lookahead 2.6 s
score = {A:4,B:2,C:0} - |f0m - prevF0|/25 - 1.5 if reused - 0.4*|dur-0.45|; gaps: period = GAPS.period*0.7*pace, comma = GAPS.comma*0.7*pace, word = min(gaps.word,0.14)*pace; pace 30–220%
playbackRate = ir.tempo / sound.tempo (if > 20) * 2^(transpose/12); sample gain clamp(vel*0.65, 0.04, 0.7); tempo 50–170, bars 8/12/16, swing <= 0.35
per query word hit +4 (len>5) or +2; instrument contains role +5; already used -4; has tempo +1; hash jitter /500
elements are 2- or 4-bar windows on the song's own bar grid (bar_s, phase) with a seam score (384 two-bar, 132 four-bar)
cut types BAR (downbeat of the grid) 542, BREATH (a rest opens) 176, SECTION 77; each cut has mask/kill; audition = 1.5 s either side with level dropped at the cut
TOUCH radius 56 px; volume = 1 - d/(TOUCH+rad); rhythm/keynote loop; keynote horizon at 0.22; fade-out -0.12 every 40 ms
no voice overlaps another voice — demanded for duets/one-cut, context-dependent
xcorr >= 0.82 = same take
prosodic isolation + signal RMS + content weight + album-wide repetition + duration fit; 12 ms edge fades, mp3 320k
